title: Set 115

sentences.ko: 우리 화요일마다 그 바에 가곤 했어. 거긴 사람이 한 명도 없었고 우리가 보고 싶은 경기를 화면에 틀어 줬거든. 그런데 가게를 싹 갈아엎더니 이제는 내내 서 있어야 하고 바로 옆 사람 말도 안 들려. 솔직히 차라리 그냥 우리 집에서 보는 게 나은데, 그렇게 생각하는 사람이 나밖에 없어서 계속 나가고 있어.
sentences.text: We used to go to that bar on Tuesdays because there was never anybody in there and they'd put whatever game we wanted up on the screen. Then they redid the whole place and now you're standing the entire time and you can't hear the person next to you. I'd honestly rather just watch it at my house, but I'm the only one who feels that way, so I keep going.

alts.text: That bar was our Tuesday spot 'cause it was always dead in there and they'd throw whatever game we wanted up on the screen. Then they gutted the place and now you're on your feet the whole night and you can't hear the guy sitting next to you. I'd way rather just watch it at my place, honestly, but nobody else feels that way, so I keep showing up.

We used to go to that bar on Tuesdays because it was never busy and the staff would put whatever game we wanted on the screen. They have since renovated the entire place, and now you stand the entire time and cannot hear the person next to you. I would genuinely prefer to watch it at my house, but I am the only one who feels that way, so I continue to go.

sentences.note: **used to go** 는 예전에는 그랬지만 지금은 안 하는 습관을 말할 때 씁니다. **I'd honestly rather** 는 차라리 그쪽이 낫다는 뜻이고, 캐주얼에서는 **way rather** 로 세게 말합니다.

sentences.ko: 이모가 한 시간 사이에 애는 언제 가질 거냐고 두 번이나 물었어. 두 번째로 물었을 때는 장모님이 바로 옆에 앉아 계셨는데, 그냥 웃고 얼음 더 가지러 갔어. 그러더니 이모부는 내가 하루 종일 도대체 무슨 일을 하는 거냐고 묻더라. 이런 저녁 자리마다 빠짐없이 설명해 드린 건데. 좋아하지, 정말 좋아해. 그런데 밥 먹으려고 앉기도 전에 이미 휴대폰을 들여다보고 있었어.
sentences.text: My aunt asked me twice in the same hour when we're having kids, and the second time she asked me with my mother-in-law sitting right there, so I laughed and went to go get more ice. And then her husband wanted to know what it is I actually do all day, which I have explained to him at every single one of these dinners. I love them, I do. But I was checking my phone before we even sat down to eat.

alts.text: Twice in one hour my aunt asked when we're having kids, and the second time my mother-in-law was sitting right there, so I laughed and went to grab more ice. Then her husband's asking what it is I actually do all day, which I've explained to him at every single one of these dinners. I love them, I really do. But I was already on my phone before we even sat down to eat.

My aunt asked me twice within the same hour when we are having children, and the second time she asked with my mother-in-law seated right there, so I laughed and went to fetch more ice. Her husband then wished to know what it is I actually do all day, which I have explained to him at every single one of these dinners. I am very fond of them, I truly am. But I was checking my phone before we had even sat down to eat.

sentences.note: **what it is I actually do all day** 는 도대체 무슨 일을 하는 거냐고 강조해서 묻는 말투입니다. **I love them, I do** 처럼 짧게 덧붙이면 앞에 한 말을 한 번 더 못 박는 느낌이 됩니다.
sentences.situation: 친척들 모인 자리에서 질문 공세 받은 얘기

sentences.ko: 좋아, 15일 주는 되는데 목요일에 출발할 때만 가능해. 그 주 금요일엔 동생이 내 차를 가져가서 공항 갈 방법이 없거든. 그다음 주는 아예 텅 비어 있으니까 그게 편하면 그렇게 말해 줘. 오늘 밤에 일정 좀 보고 되든 안 되든 알려 줄래? 한 달 안으로 들어오면 항공권 값이 오르기 시작해.
sentences.text: Okay, so I can do the week of the fifteenth, but only if we fly out Thursday, because my sister has my car that Friday and I'd have no way to get to the airport. The week after that I'm wide open, so if that's easier for you just say so. Can you look at your calendar tonight and tell me either way? The flights start going up once we're a month out.

alts.text: So the week of the fifteenth works, but only if we fly out Thursday, 'cause my sister's got my car that Friday and I'd have no way to get to the airport. The week after that I'm totally free, so if that's easier for you just tell me. Can you check your calendar tonight and let me know either way? Flights start climbing once we're a month out.

I am able to manage the week of the fifteenth, but only if we depart on Thursday, as my sister has my car that Friday and I would have no way to reach the airport. The following week I am entirely free, so if that is easier for you, please do say so. Could you look at your calendar this evening and tell me either way? The fares begin to rise once we are a month out.

sentences.note: **either way** 는 되든 안 되든 어느 쪽인지 알려 달라는 뜻입니다. **wide open** 은 일정이 통째로 비어 있다는 말이고, **a month out** 은 그날까지 한 달 남았다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 3월에 기타를 샀고 3주쯤은 매일 밤 20분씩 쳤어. 그러다 하루를 걸렀는데 사실상 그걸로 끝이었어. 기타는 아직도 소파 옆에 그대로 나와 있어. 눈에 보여야 미안해서라도 집어 들겠지 싶어서 거기 둔 거야. 제일 아까운 건 손가락이 드디어 안 아파지기 시작했다는 거야. 딱 재미있어지는 지점에 와 있었는데. 이제는 그냥 지나쳐 다녀.
sentences.text: I bought the guitar back in March and I was doing twenty minutes every night for about three weeks, and then I skipped one night and that was pretty much the end of it. It's still sitting out by the couch where I have to look at it, because I figured that would guilt me into picking it up. And the worst part is my fingers had finally quit hurting, so I was right at the point where it starts being fun. Now I just walk past it.

alts.text: I picked up the guitar back in March and I was doing twenty minutes a night for about three weeks, then I skipped one night and that was pretty much it. It's still parked by the couch where I've gotta look at it, 'cause I figured that'd guilt me into picking it up. Worst part is my fingers had finally quit hurting, so I was right at the point where it starts being fun. Now I just walk on past it.

I purchased the guitar back in March and I practised twenty minutes every night for roughly three weeks, and then I missed one night and that was very nearly the end of it. It is still sitting out beside the couch where I am obliged to look at it, because I assumed that would shame me into picking it up. The worst of it is that my fingers had finally stopped hurting, so I was right at the point where it begins to be enjoyable. Now I simply walk past it.

sentences.note: **guilt me into picking it up** 은 죄책감이 들게 만들어서 결국 손에 들게 한다는 뜻입니다. **that was pretty much the end of it** 은 그걸로 사실상 끝났다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 시내에서 두 시간을 때워야 해서 도서관 옆 커피집에 갔어. 그런데 테이블마다 노트북 앞에 헤드폰 쓴 사람이 앉아 있고, 하나같이 앞에 물 한 컵만 놓여 있더라. 그래서 길 건너 다른 가게로 갔는데 거기도 똑같았어. 결국 주차장에 세워 둔 내 차 안에 앉아서 커피를 마셨는데, 솔직히 그날 하루 중에 거기가 제일 조용했어.
sentences.text: I had two hours to kill downtown, so I went to the coffee place by the library and every single table had somebody on a laptop with headphones on, and every one of them just had a cup of water in front of them. So I walked over to the other place across the street and it was exactly the same. I ended up sitting in my car in the garage with my coffee, and honestly that was the quietest place I'd been all day.

alts.text: Had two hours to kill downtown, so I hit the coffee place by the library and every table had somebody on a laptop with headphones on, and every one of them just had a cup of water sitting there. So I headed over to the other one across the street and it was the exact same thing. I wound up in my car in the garage with my coffee, and honestly that was the quietest spot I'd been all day.

I had two hours to fill downtown, so I went to the coffee shop beside the library, and every single table held someone on a laptop wearing headphones, and each of them had only a cup of water in front of them. I then walked to the other shop across the street, and it was exactly the same. I ended up sitting in my car in the garage with my coffee, and in truth that was the quietest place I had been all day.

sentences.note: **two hours to kill** 은 남는 두 시간을 때워야 한다는 뜻입니다. **ended up** 은 이리저리 하다가 결국 그렇게 됐다는 말이고, 캐주얼의 **wound up** 도 같은 뜻입니다.

reviewed: 1번 note 의 **I'd rather** 가 문장에 그대로 나오지 않아(text 는 "I'd honestly rather") 별표를 실제 나오는 형태로 맞췄습니다.
1번 formal 의 "one stands ... cannot hear the person alongside" 는 원어민이 안 쓰는 말이라 "you stand ... cannot hear the person next to you" 로 고쳤습니다.
1번 한국어의 "바로 옆에 앉은 사람" 이 영어(the person next to you)와 어긋나 "바로 옆 사람" 으로, "훨씬 나은데" 는 I'd rather 에 맞춰 "차라리 ... 나은데" 로 고쳤습니다.
5번 casual 이 text 와 첫 마디("I had two hours to kill downtown, so I")가 똑같아 앞부분을 구어체로 바꿨습니다.
5번 formal 의 "two hours to occupy" 와 "the other establishment" 가 어색해 "two hours to fill", "the other shop" 으로 고쳤습니다.
